cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

provenance.purpose: Text-only throughput, no cursor or disk, production renderer and hardware reads

pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

fixture_correction: The first G3 mapping observer expected its initial 3fff0 transfer. New list tests ran first, legitimately mapping another bank. Move list checks after that initial transfer. Both raw/optimized fresh map-nmi cases pass, including lists, pixels, SIO, complete context and cleanup. Earlier nine optimized and two raw cases passed; reports retain the observer failure instead of hiding it.
environment: A shared SDK symlink disappeared during execution. Copied the unchanged hash-verified shell-paced emulator and SDK from the pinned source into workspace-local build/shell-paced-bridge, then replayed the concurrent image successfully.

vram.note: Exclusive display ownership. B1 replaces the 256-byte BCB area with one 4096-byte command arena. At most 64 records and 8192 estimated bus accesses per submission. Font, scratch, cursor and CPU aperture unchanged.

timings.scope: Optimized elapsed production-path measurements with passive observation; no mouse drawing or disk in text benchmark.

limitations: The bounded copy costs more total time than the old single long blit; B3/B7/B8 must address this before claiming the scroll target.
Current limits bound estimated work; exact two-millisecond occupancy and four-millisecond owner CPU goals are not yet established.
Raw/optimized pixel, recovery and context development checks are not full hosted-system or physical-hardware qualification.
